_comment: Chef-curated names for the V3 HDBSCAN-UMAP clusters. Keyed by cluster_id (stable at seed=42 with HDBSCAN min_cluster_size=40, method=leaf on the imputed embedding). Cluster IDs and compositions WILL SHIFT when the chef CSV is expanded — these labels were curated against the 209-row chef CSV. If you expand the CSV further, re-inspect cluster compositions and refine the labels here. The chemistry label is preserved in cluster_labels_v3.json[].chemistry_label.

0.notes: Waxes, ethereal volatiles, cananga (ylang-ylang) — specialty floral/waxy chemistry.

1.notes: Herbs (thyme + oregano + sage + rosemary), anise-family spices, phenolic compounds.

2.notes: Mega-cluster (1,107 / 33% of corpus). Dairy + meaty + savory/cooked staples — the cooking-foundation cluster.

3.notes: Alliums (garlic, onion, shallot, leek), briny/fermented umami, toasted/oriental savory.

4.notes: Pulpy fruits, floral notes, citrus + tropical fruit chemistry.
